items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: The interviewee mentions Bessie Smith only in the context of timeline ('years before Bessie Smith came along', 'after our time') and references a pianist who played for her, but states no personal interaction with Bessie Smith himself.

ctx.x: When was this that Miss Todd was singing?
All the way from 1913 to 1925. And that was a good ten to twelve years before Bessie was
alive. That's right, from 1913. She didn't sing blues? Well, huh? Or did she?
